name: fast-paste-win
description: Instant clipboard-image paste for Claude Code on Windows. One background PowerShell watches the clipboard and saves screenshots ahead of time, so Alt+V attaches them with no delay. Paste one, paste all, or pick from a gallery.

pasteKey.title: Paste shortcut
pasteKey.description: Key that pastes the image you just copied. Claude Code key syntax, e.g. alt+v. Run the fast-paste-setup skill after changing it.

viewKey.title: View shortcut
viewKey.description: Key that opens the pasted image(s) in a window, e.g. alt+i.

pasteAllKey.title: Paste-all shortcut
pasteAllKey.description: Key that pastes every image copied since your last message, e.g. alt+a.

pickKey.title: Pick shortcut
pickKey.description: Key that opens the gallery to pick images, e.g. alt+g.
